evals.prompt: My dentist says I should switch to an electric toothbrush. Is it actually better than a manual one, or is that marketing? I don't want your opinion, show me the evidence.
evals.expected_output: quote-pack.html built by scripts/quotepack.py from several reputable sources (e.g. Cochrane, dental associations), including a caveat or limitation passage; chat reply is logistics only with no summary of the argument.
assertions: quote-pack.html exists and was generated by quotepack.py (has the quotepack generator meta tag and embedded manifest)
Every quoted passage on the page appears verbatim in its cited source snapshot (no paraphrase, no partial sentences)
The page contains no AI-written prose: no headings, summaries or commentary beyond the script's fixed strings
The pack draws on at least 3 distinct sources, mostly primary/accountable ones
The pack includes at least one passage giving a caveat, limitation or opposing view
The chat reply (reply.md) sticks to logistics and does not summarise the argument or give the model's own conclusion
